implementation: independent canonical 2-D curves; follows native sample-domain comparison, not the original external Inviwo binary
orientation: x=column, y=row, origin=(0,0), no orientation selection
domain: minimal power-of-two square; discard exterior cells; traverse every retained cell exactly once
values: all processed scalar samples preserved unchanged
anchor: extremum grid-sample rank; same per-method occupied-anchor-range decision normalization
native_topology: max pairwise native/source LCA merge-level error per frame; temporal max and mean; no optimal refilling
fragmentation: disjoint runs in the native ordering per source leaf support; average over supports and frames
main_pm25: January 1-30 2000 selected after seasonal comparison; 7 clear events; other months and original January-February retained
